description: ABSOLUTE calendar window: all forecasts whose due date falls between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive), whatever their outcome (open and already closed), ordered by due date then ID. Use it for "what falls due in Q1 2027" or to review a past period. For "what is open and due soon or overdue relative to today" use due_forecasts. Returns at most `limit` entries (default 10, max 50) with total (all matches), count (returned) and truncated; if truncated, narrow the window. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

from.description: Start of the due-date window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2027-01-01.

limit.description: Maximum number of forecasts to return (default 10, max 50). The response reports total and truncated.

to.description: End of the due-date window, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after from. Example: 2027-03-31.

name: list_due
